name: Generate lists of positive affirmations and subliminal audio ideas
description: Users requested lists of positive affirmations or subliminal audio concepts designed to address specific personal goals, such as improving physical and mental health, overcoming addictions, enhancing relationships, or boosting confidence. These instructions frequently specified the quantity, tone, or format of the affirmations, and sometimes included requests for related meditation scripts or guidance on manifestation techniques.
